novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is an internal measurement of deception: “a linear probe over intermediate activations that separates sincere from deceptive generation” while capturing “belief-assertion divergence,” generalizing across contexts, and facing adaptive evasion. Searches framed as “linear probe deceptive honest internal activations adaptive evasion,” “LLM lie detection belief assertion divergence cross-context generalization,” and “deception probes black-to-white monitoring” identify essentially equivalent prior work: Benchmarking Deception Probes via Black-to-White Performance Boosts (2025) already studies linear classifiers on activations during deceptive versus honest responses and resistance to counter-strategies, while Liars’ Bench (2025) evaluates white-box lie detectors across diverse reasons for lying and belief targets; Truth is Universal (2024) also constructs an activation-based detector for knowingly generated falsehoods. Thus the proposed cross-domain evaluation and probe-evasion stress test are, at most, natural extensions of an already established research instance rather than a new core relationship or measurement paradigm.
